about: Lane scripts vendored from GridAtlas #73 work lanes, run as they were delivered (each in its own schema). pipelines/run_lanes.py runs them; ci/verify.py pins every file; reproduce.py rebuilds the deterministic ones.

lanes.title: NESO TEC and Embedded registers: data-centre-like rows (grid connection MW only)
lanes.licence: NESO Open Data Licence (OGL v3-derived; owner to confirm)
lanes.attribution: Supported by National Energy SO Open Data
lanes.notes: Fetch and normalise are one step. TEC and Embedded hold generation, so expect few or no data-centre rows; a miss is 'not identified', not zero. The EA register (--include-ea) is left off: licence unverified.

lanes.title: Government-published data-centre sites (AI Growth Zones, s35 directions, recovered appeals)
lanes.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0
lanes.notes: Records are curated from cited GOV.UK, gov.scot and gov.wales pages; fetch snapshots every cited page and checks each quote still appears. Some cited domains are marked unverified per record.

lanes.title: Operational data centres mapped in OpenStreetMap, matched to Wikidata
lanes.notes: Without a live Overpass snapshot the build falls back to the pinned globalgrid2050 datacentres.geojson (240 points, name and operator only).

lanes.title: Merged UK data-centre pipeline (schema, de-duplication, conflicts)
lanes.licence: per record (ODbL-1.0 where any OSM source contributes)
lanes.notes: Runs after the other lanes. Rejects any record without a fully open licence, a URL or a name.
